test_iou_piecewise_sampler: test the IoUNegPiecewiseSampler with MaxIoUAssigner on 3D lidar bounding boxes using PyTorch CUDA tensors
run_MaxIoUAssigner_assign: run MaxIoUAssigner to assign 3D bounding boxes to ground truth boxes using IoU thresholds and BboxOverlaps3D calculator
run_IoUNegPiecewiseSampler_sample: run IoUNegPiecewiseSampler to sample positive and negative bounding box proposals with piecewise IoU fraction thresholds
create_MaxIoUAssigner: create a MaxIoUAssigner with configurable positive and negative IoU thresholds and a 3D bounding box overlap calculator
create_IoUNegPiecewiseSampler: create an IoUNegPiecewiseSampler with configurable sample count, positive fraction, and piecewise negative IoU thresholds
